title: Own display-name update request v1
description: PATCH /api/v1/me/profile request body: a closed object with exactly one key, `name`. This is the WIRE bound only. The service additionally NFC-normalizes and trims the value and then requires 1-80 Unicode code points without control, bidi, zero-width or separator characters (`maxLength` below counts code points; a body is at most 1024 bytes). Those post-normalization rules cannot be expressed here and are enforced by the service; the response contract (`http.profile.v1`) carries the normalized result. Identity, email and roles are never accepted from the client.

name.description: Untrusted display text as typed. May carry surrounding whitespace the service trims.
